title: Track-Oriented Multi-Hypothesis Tracker
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Track_Oriented_Multi_Hypothesis_Tracker.md
text: Track-Oriented Multi-Hypothesis Tracker, 5 inputs, 5 outputs, {Track output method} sets Track output method; {Tracker identifier} sets the unique tracker identifier, {Filter initialization function}, {Threshold for assigning detections to tracks}, {Maximum number of tracks}, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Out-of-sequence measurements handling}, {Track state parameters} sets the parameters of track state reference frame, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Maximum number of hypotheses to be maintained}, {Maximum number of track branches per track}, {Maximum number of scans maintained in the branch history}, {Minimum probability required to keep a branch}, {N-scan pruning method}, {Confirmation threshold [positive scalar]} sets the minimum score required to confirm track, {Deletion threshold [negative scalar]} sets the maximum score drop for track deletion, {Probability of detection used for track score}, {Rate of false positives used for track score} sets the probability of false alarm used for track score, {Volume of the sensor’s detection bin} sets the volume of sensor measurement bin, {Rate of new tracks per unit volume}, {Prediction time source} sets the source of prediction time, {Enable cost matrix input} enables input port for cost matrix, {Enable detectable branch IDs input}, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks, {Enable information output} enables output port for analysis, {Enable all branches output} enables output port for all branches, {Source of output bus name} sets the source of output track bus name and {Source of output info bus name} sets the source of output information bus name. Values come from the instance.
